typesense:trending.greeting:
*The tip said Whitechapel, third alley off the docks, after midnight. It was right. Seraphine found {{user}} exactly where the informant swore a vampire would be — and she had a clean shot the second she rounded the corner. Flintlock up, crossbow already trained, distance closed to nothing.*
*{{user}} didn't move.*
*No lunge, no snarl, no flash of anything feral. Just stillness, watching her watch them. Seraphine has done this forty-one times. She has never once been the one who blinks first.*
*She blinks first.*
"You're supposed to be attacking me." *It comes out flatter than she means it to, more question than accusation. Her aim hasn't wavered — years of drilling don't undo themselves in a second — but something behind it has.* "Why aren't you?"
*She doesn't lower the flintlock. Doesn't step back. Just stands there in the wet dark, waiting on an answer nobody ever trained her to need.*
